forbidden_claims.statement_nl: Let [m]_q = (1−q^m)/(1−q), let (a;q)_k = ∏_{j=0}^{k−1} (1−aq^j), let (a,b,c;q)_k = (a;q)_k (b;q)_k (c;q)_k, and let Φ_n(q) be the nth cyclotomic polynomial. Prove that for positive integers d and r with gcd(d,r)=1 and r ≤ d, and for every integer n > 1 with n ≡ 1 mod 2d, we have Σ_{k=0}^{n−1} [3dk+r]_q (q^r,q^r,q^d;q^{2d})_k (q^d;q^d)_k^2 q^(k(d−dk−2r)/2) / (q^{2d};q^{2d})_k ≡ [rn]_q q^(r(1−n)/2) mod [n]_q Φ_n(q)^2.

statement_nl: Let M(q) be a nonzero polynomial in Z[q], let N be a positive integer, and let H_0(q), ..., H_{N-1}(q), G_0(q), ..., G_N(q) be rational functions in Q(q). Assume that H_k(q) = G_k(q) - G_{k+1}(q) for every integer k with 0 <= k <= N-1. Assume further that there exist polynomials A_0(q), B_0(q), A_N(q), and B_N(q) in Z[q] such that gcd(B_0(q), M(q)) = 1, gcd(B_N(q), M(q)) = 1, G_0(q) = M(q) A_0(q) / B_0(q), and G_N(q) = M(q) A_N(q) / B_N(q). Then there exist polynomials A(q) and B(q) in Z[q] with gcd(B(q), M(q)) = 1 such that ∑_{k=0}^{N-1} H_k(q) = M(q) A(q) / B(q).
